# `gameplay/narrative/StoryGraph.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/narrative/StoryGraph.js`

StoryGraph — Storylet engine for LIFE. Stories are storylets, not one fixed script. A storylet is a small reusable story event that triggers when conditions are true. Each storylet has: trigger conditions, cast, stakes, choices, consequences, memories, and graph updates.

## Functions

### `createStorylet(config)`

Create a storylet definition.

**Parameters:**

- `config` *(object)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `config.id` *(string)* — Unique storylet ID
- `config.name` *(string)* — Human-readable name
- `config.tags` *(string[])* — Content tags
- `config.canTrigger` *(function)* — (worldState) => boolean
- `config.execute` *(function)* — (worldState, cast) => { narrative, consequences, memories }
- `[config.selectCast]` *(function)* — (worldState) => object — pick NPCs to fill roles
- `[config.cooldown` *(number)* — =60000] - Min ms between fires
- `[config.priority` *(number)* — =5] - Higher = checked first
- `[config.maxFires` *(number)* — =0] - 0 = unlimited
- `[config.description]` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
